aerobic-septic-system-cost.title: How Much Does an Aerobic Septic System Cost in 2026?
aerobic-septic-system-cost.short_answer: An aerobic septic system (aerobic treatment unit, or ATU) costs $10,000 to $20,000 to install, according to Angi's 2026 data, while HomeGuide puts an engineered ATU at $20,000 to $40,000 or more.
